parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-03 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 177.8 | 13.27 | 13.27
2 | 265.8 | 3.40 | 16.67
3 | 1064.5 | 8.81 | 25.48
4 | 2584.7 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as AA-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-03
Curve type: AA-type
Aquifer depth: 0 – 16.67 m
Recommendation: Target the weathered/fractured overburden (Layers 1–2, down to ~16.7 m) as the primary water-bearing zone, since resistivity rises sharply below this depth indicating competent, low-porosity fresh basement. Drilling beyond ~17 m is unlikely to improve yield and should only be considered if secondary fracture zones are logged during drilling.
